in_arabic.name: Malouf
in_arabic.long_meaning: Malouf هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic word 'malawwah' meaning 'graceful, beautiful, elegant'. It is also a surname that originated in Syria and Lebanon.
